create:
Create one app called Personal Life Manager with these three tracks:
Businesses — Track businesses I visit. Create 5 entries: Berghotel Grosse Scheidegg, Amazon, Walmart, McDonald’s, and Shell.
Expenses — Track my personal expenses. Create 6 entries: groceries at Walmart for $120, dinner at McDonald’s for $35, an Amazon purchase for $85, fuel at Shell for $60, hotel expenses at Berghotel Grosse Scheidegg for $200, and a coffee purchase for $8.
Contacts — Track people and organizations I deal with. Create 4 entries: John Smith, Sarah Johnson, ABC Construction, and XYZ Supplies.
